supersession.reason: Reconcile analysis coverage, response semantics, progression reporting, and the public H1 evidence boundary before any qualifying package exists.

purpose: Define auditable result slots, privacy-safe public package boundaries, and evidence-promotion gates without representing absent observations as zeroes or creating example findings.

evidence_policy.empty_state: Use unavailable, blocked, not run, not collected, or not applicable. Never encode an absent result as zero.
evidence_policy.synthetic_state: Synthetic fixtures may verify schemas and failure handling but cannot become human observations, affective findings, or evidence of benefit.
evidence_policy.technical_state: Technical conformance or performance remains technical evidence and cannot establish subjective fit, therapeutic efficacy, clinical safety, or neurological mechanism.
evidence_policy.human_state: Human-response values require separately authorized H1 collection, protocol-qualified records, audited deviations, the frozen analysis plan, and privacy-reviewed aggregate public envelopes.
evidence_policy.nonpositive_state: Null, opposite-direction, mismatched, burdensome, harmful, not_prompted, declined, missed_window, technical_failure, interrupted, not_applicable, stopped, failed, and adverse records retain first-class reporting positions.
evidence_policy.public_package_state: A committed public package contains only privacy-reviewed aggregate accounting and public-safe artifacts. Raw or row-level human records remain private and are not repository evidence.

effect_estimates.reporting_rule: Retain every prespecified within-person estimand and its session- or block-level inputs in protected analysis output. The public envelope reports only privacy-reviewed aggregate estimates, exact denominators, and evidence class; do not select a preferred contrast after observation.

uncertainty.reporting_rule: Retain all session points and the exact within-block permutation vector in protected analysis output. The public envelope reports exact aggregate denominators, descriptive spread, the observed statistic, tail count, denominator 720, exact proportion, and privacy-reviewed distribution summaries only when the frozen conditions are met.

exact_randomization_analysis.reporting_rule: Report eligibility separately for every named outcome and contrast. When eligible, report the observed statistic, inclusive two-sided tail count, exact denominator 720, exact p-value, and privacy-reviewed distribution summaries; retain the full 720-value vector in protected analysis output.

visualizations.reporting_rule: Populate a governed visual only from its qualifying source package and analysis output; display denominators, missingness, failures, uncertainty, and evidence stage.

missingness.reporting_rule: For every response field, report aggregate present-value accounting separately from the exact canonical missingness reasons not_prompted, declined, missed_window, technical_failure, interrupted, and not_applicable. Unsure is a present wanted-intensity or ongoing-effect answer, not missingness. Do not impute the primary analysis.

sensitivity_analyses.reporting_rule: Report every prespecified sensitivity view beside the primary descriptive result; do not use sensitivity analyses to replace an unfavorable primary view.

progression_decision.reporting_rule: Report every prespecified progression criterion as pass, fail, or indeterminate, separate audit completeness from usable voluntary response completeness, show missing-value bound decisions, and report the final stop, revise, or proceed disposition without implying advisory usefulness, improved targeting, efficacy, or safety.

promotion_gates.gate: Repository artifacts pass deterministic validation and are described only as design records.
promotion_gates.required_review: Confirm artifact identity, byte lock, source revision, and claim-ledger wording.
promotion_gates.never_supports: Runtime performance, user response, benefit, safety, or efficacy.

promotion_gates.gate: Issue #18 completes one bounded synthetic vertical-slice package with every planned success, rejection, failure, recovery, and denominator.
promotion_gates.required_review: Review source revision, environment, commands, manifests, structured outputs, failures, exclusions, hashes, and claim-ledger disposition before promotion.
promotion_gates.never_supports: Human exposure, affective response, subjective fit, benefit, safety, or efficacy.

promotion_gates.gate: A real model, adapter, analyzer, hardware profile, thresholds, seeds, and attempt matrix are frozen before qualifying execution.
promotion_gates.required_review: Verify complete technical denominators, unsupported controls, missing runs, failures, uncertainty, and source hashes before promotion.
promotion_gates.never_supports: Affective correctness, user need, benefit, safety, or efficacy.

promotion_gates.gate: Every human-collection activation gate is independently cleared before the first qualifying record.
promotion_gates.required_review: Audit collection authority, assignment, consent, provenance, deviations, eligibility, missingness, analysis outputs, and claim-ledger disposition.
promotion_gates.never_supports: Useful advisory relationships, improved targeting, population generalization, clinical efficacy, clinical safety, diagnosis, treatment, or neurological mechanism.

result_slots.reporting_rule: Report artifact identity and traceability only, never performance.
result_slots.prohibited_inference: A complete design record does not prove implementation, feasibility, safety, or benefit.

result_slots.reporting_rule: After issue #18 and ledger review, report every planned success, rejection, failure, recovery, and denominator as synthetic technical evidence.
result_slots.prohibited_inference: Mock conformance is not human exposure, affective response, benefit, or safety.

result_slots.reporting_rule: Report every planned, generated, partial, cancelled, failed, verified, played, and excluded technical attempt with complete aggregate accounting.
result_slots.prohibited_inference: Complete attempt accounting is not control adherence, perceived quality, benefit, or safety.

result_slots.reporting_rule: Report every prespecified authority and artifact-integrity invariant as pass, fail, or unavailable with its qualifying denominator.
result_slots.prohibited_inference: Passing a technical invariant does not establish human authority in use, subjective fit, benefit, or safety.

result_slots.reporting_rule: Report paired requested-versus-measured differences by factor and seed with uncertainty and unsupported controls.
result_slots.prohibited_inference: Acoustic adherence is not perceived expression, felt response, or benefit.

result_slots.reporting_rule: Report component latency and verified buffer margin with complete denominators and hardware context.
result_slots.prohibited_inference: Meeting a generation deadline does not prove seamless perception or benefit.

result_slots.reporting_rule: Report semantic and waveform boundary components separately alongside cancellations, partial outputs, failures, and recoveries.
result_slots.prohibited_inference: A low boundary score does not establish perceived smoothness, emotional fit, or safety.

result_slots.reporting_rule: Report assigned, attempted, verified, played, completed, interrupted, postponed, and withdrawn records by condition with exact denominators.
result_slots.prohibited_inference: Generation, verification, or assignment is not exposure or completion.

result_slots.reporting_rule: Report every immediate field as present or with exactly one canonical reason: not_prompted, declined, missed_window, technical_failure, interrupted, or not_applicable.
result_slots.prohibited_inference: Missing or declined response is not neutral response or zero.

result_slots.reporting_rule: Report every later field as present or with exactly one canonical reason: not_prompted, declined, missed_window, technical_failure, interrupted, or not_applicable.
result_slots.prohibited_inference: An absent later record cannot be interpreted as no aftereffect.

result_slots.reporting_rule: Report whether semantic, acoustic, exposure, response, correction, and safety aggregates reconcile across privacy-reviewed public envelopes and the private audit index.
result_slots.prohibited_inference: A reconciled commitment is an integrity check, not proof of anonymity, consent, authenticity, truth, efficacy, or safety.

result_slots.reporting_rule: Report each frozen criterion as pass, fail, or indeterminate, including separate audit-completeness and usable-voluntary-response criteria, before the final disposition. If the observed and bounded burden decisions disagree, that criterion is indeterminate and the final disposition is revise.
result_slots.prohibited_inference: A proceed disposition authorizes no collection and does not establish advisory usefulness, improved targeting, efficacy, generalizability, privacy, or safety.

result_slots.reporting_rule: Retain session-level perceived-expression and felt-state values separately in protected analysis output. Report only privacy-reviewed aggregate summaries of their paired differences publicly, without declaring either report correct.
result_slots.prohibited_inference: Musical expression is not the listener's state, and neither is an objective need label.

result_slots.reporting_rule: Compute condition-specific immediate-minus-baseline valence and arousal only for paired present observations, retain session points privately, and report privacy-reviewed summaries with exact aggregate accounting publicly.
result_slots.prohibited_inference: Within-session state change is not proof that the audio caused, improved, or treated anything.

result_slots.reporting_rule: Retain every session point and frozen blockwise P-minus-S, P-minus-G, and S-minus-G contrast in protected output; publicly report only privacy-reviewed aggregate summaries for helpfulness, resonance, mismatch, harm, interaction burden, and session burden separately.
result_slots.prohibited_inference: These contrasts compare bundled conditions; they cannot isolate personalization, context access, plan editing, population effects, clinical outcomes, or causality.

result_slots.reporting_rule: When every frozen condition is met, retain all 720 assignment statistics in protected output and publicly report the observed statistic, inclusive tail count, exact denominator 720, exact proportion, and privacy-reviewed distribution summaries for every named contrast.
result_slots.prohibited_inference: The 720-value distribution is exploratory within-person uncertainty, not population inference or a confirmatory test.

result_slots.reporting_rule: Report every frozen sensitivity view beside the primary descriptive result, including any indeterminate missing-bound decision.
result_slots.prohibited_inference: A sensitivity view cannot replace an unfavorable primary result or repair missing information.

result_slots.reporting_rule: Retain immediate and later felt state, helpfulness, harm, ongoing effect, and optional person-authored meaning as separate window-specific protected records; publish only privacy-reviewed aggregate summaries and accounting.
result_slots.prohibited_inference: Later meaning does not retroactively convert intensity into benefit or harm.

result_slots.reporting_rule: Retain zero movement, null contrasts, and opposite-direction movement with the same visibility as favorable direction.
result_slots.prohibited_inference: Null does not mean missing, and opposite-direction movement is not automatically harm.

result_slots.reporting_rule: Report mismatch and whether intensity was unwanted without collapsing them into harm.
result_slots.prohibited_inference: Intensity, crying, or engagement is not automatic success or failure.

result_slots.reporting_rule: Report interaction and total-session burden separately with their declared anchors.
result_slots.prohibited_inference: Low burden does not establish benefit, safety, or meaningful consent.

result_slots.reporting_rule: Report aggregate counts for harm, high harm, repeated high harm, serious events, unresolved events, distress, hearing discomfort, consent or privacy failure, technical safety failure, participant-described adverse responses, and every review disposition separately.
result_slots.prohibited_inference: No observed adverse event would prove clinical safety.

result_slots.reporting_rule: Report each field as present or with exactly one canonical reason: not_prompted, declined, missed_window, technical_failure, interrupted, or not_applicable. Report wanted-intensity and ongoing-effect unsure as present answers, never as missing.
result_slots.prohibited_inference: Missing, declined, and unavailable are distinct and none equals zero.

result_slots.reporting_rule: Keep stops, interruptions, technical failures, partial exposure, and withdrawals in the attempt ledger and denominators.
result_slots.prohibited_inference: A stopped session cannot be silently replaced, excluded, or classified as a completed exposure.

result_slots.reporting_rule: Do not create a physiology panel or result row under protocol version 1.1.0.
result_slots.prohibited_inference: Physiology cannot diagnose emotion or need, overwrite self-report, prove entrainment, or imply benefit.

public_package_policy.evidence_set_rule: Every H1 flow, response, safety, and audit envelope must carry the same evidence_set_id, commitment_profile, evidence_set_sha256, protocol identity and hash, analysis-plan identity and hash, deviation-log hash, and aggregate record count. Cross-package accounting must reconcile before any slot can be promoted.
public_package_policy.commitment_rule: The H1 evidence-set SHA-256 is an integrity commitment over a canonically sorted private evidence index, a private random nonce, and a domain separator. The nonce and private index remain outside Git. The commitment is not proof of anonymity, consent, authenticity, truth, or completeness.
public_package_policy.artifacts_rule: The common artifacts field may contain only privacy-reviewed aggregate derived artifacts or public-safe repository references. It must never contain a row-level payload, private path, participant artifact, or per-record hash.
public_allowed: aggregate missingness, exclusion, interruption, failure, and withdrawal accounting
public_package_policy.private_index_rule: The private evidence index may use package-local opaque references and payload hashes but remains outside the public repository. Its retention disposition is retained-private, destroyed-with-tombstone, or not-applicable.
public_package_policy.physiology_rule: The reserved physiology envelope remains disabled and cannot join ANT-ESET-H1-001 without a separately governed protocol amendment.
